{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABaxtDUQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhEXv-c", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 55, "title": "Remove synthetic box/wedge rigs from the public demo UI", "body": "## Problem

The public MMD → glTF demo currently exposes **Synthetic rigs** (box/wedge PMX fixtures and 24 technical presets) next to Uka and Gene Light. These deliberately artificial fixtures are useful for precise numerical/GPU conformance, but visually confusing as an end-user example; their prominent menu option and long explanatory block in the public demo distract from real-character comparison.

## Expected outcome

The normal demo presents **Uka and Gene Light only**. No synthetic box/wedge model or technical rig preset is offered in the visible public model picker, and the public About & credits section focuses on the actual character models. Retain the box/wedge fixtures and their numerical, shader, IK/physics and animation regression tests: this is a **public-demo/UI scope change**, not permission to delete valuable testing.

## Context and reproduction

- Public demo: https://takahirox.github.io/mmd-gltf/
- Current markup and navigation: `examples/index.html`, `examples/demo.ts`, `examples/rig.html`.
- The browser conformance suites rely on the existing rig controls, IDs and `?demo=rig` deep link; these should remain accessible as **internal test plumbing**, not advertised to visitors.
- Related: Uka integration #52 / PR #53, CPU-backed SwiftShader CI optimization #54.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] The public demo's visible model selector offers only Uka and Gene Light, with no synthetic rig/preset choice in normal navigation.
- [ ] Remove the synthetic-rig tutorial, test-model download links, and technical exposition from the visitor-facing About & credits section; place any DOM elements needed for rig diagnostics inside the internal fixture area.
- [ ] The existing `?demo=rig` and legacy `rig.html` entry points remain usable **for automated conformance tests only**. Do not introduce public links to them. Preserve the test fixture assets and all dependent tests; no reduction in numerical/renderer coverage is required.
- [ ] Add a regression check that the public dropdown contains only the two real models while the internal fixture deep link still works.
- [ ] Update the README/UI documentation so it clearly distinguishes public character comparisons from non-public test harnesses and does not invite visitors to choose Synthetic rigs.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, relevant Playwright tests, and `git diff --check` pass. Prefer full CI for this UI change; no unrelated refactor or added test permutations.

## Optional validation

Capture the public desktop/mobile model selector and About & credits section to verify that no synthetic test models are offered.

## Required post-merge verification

Check the deployed Pages model selector and credits after the merge-triggered deployment, plus the success of the workflow. No hardware-GPU review is required.
